《字林西报》，1931年8月25日，星期二
2177

运往广州的第二批军火货物被截获

“博纳斯”号轮船由海关巡舰护送入港
船上弹药足以消灭一支军队；容克飞机被没收

另一座浮动军火库，“博纳斯”号（Bonus），德国瑞克梅尔轮船公司（Rickmers Line）装载着成吨武器、弹药和炸药、预计三天内抵达上海的第二艘船只，于昨日进港。
与第一艘船“R. C. 瑞克梅尔”号（R. C. Rickmers）的情况一样，在该船由海关巡舰、重装甲海关汽艇以及从日常勤务中能调集的所有水上警察护送，从中国管辖权的12海里界限进入吴淞后，国民政府扣押了估计数量比第一艘船更多的武器和弹药。

原系运往广州
正如《字林西报》在周日和周一独家报道的那样，这批军火最初是托运给广东各派系的。据说南京官员得知了这批装运情况，并下令将军火直接交付上海，否则将对中国港口实施抵制作为惩罚。因此，这些船只避开了广东水域，载着货物直接来到上海。
昨日对“R. C. 瑞克梅尔”号货物的检查揭示了令人震惊数量的武器、弹药和炸药。

飞机被扣押
三架最新型号的容克（Junkers）驱逐机、600挺机枪、数百箱弹药、数百支毛瑟左轮手枪、步枪和其他枪支被列入被缴获的战斗装备之中。
在江西路451号的瑞克梅尔轮船公司代理处，货物舱单显示，“R. C. 瑞克梅尔”号带入港口的爆炸物数量惊人，其中包括：
大批T.N.T.装运
无烟火药 53,200公斤
T.N.T. 25,200 „
达纳迈特炸药 73,500磅
雷管 2,010 „
Fetonators（原文如此，疑为雷管拼写错误） 5,925 „
胶质炸药 1,365公斤
达纳迈特炸药 5,460 „
雷管 225 „
无烟火药 67 „
爆破胶 3,870磅
摩擦管 680 „
雷管 127 „
爆破胶 1,245 „
所有上述货物均根据海关当局的指示，在吴淞由注册驳船卸下。预计“博纳斯”号的货物与此相同，但数量更大。
“R. C. 瑞克梅尔”号船长D. Harff昨日向《字林西报》发表声明，否认他本人或其公司卷入中国政治。

不喜媒体采访
“我仅仅是我这条船的船长，”Harff船长宣称。“我公司的业务是将任何合法性质的货物从一个港口运输到另一个港口。我处理这批货物就像处理其他任何货物一样。”
Harff船长对报社记者的来访并不持欢迎态度。“在前一次前往上海的航程中，报纸报道我卷入了一笔价值100万美元的鸦片装运。我的声誉几乎被毁，”这位船长说。他宣称自己在那次事件中像在这次事件中一样，对媒体的指控是无辜的。

描述扣押过程
Harff船长欣然向《字林西报》代表描述了军火被扣押的过程。
“当我们进入中国水域时，我在驾驶台上，”这位航运人士叙述道。“毫无预警地，一艘中国海关巡舰靠近，并用灯光照射船名。我们询问他们想要什么，巡舰上的官员要求我们停船并抛锚。
‘对此，引水员表示反对，’船长继续说道。‘我们大声回应说，我们正位于一条电缆的正上方，在此处抛锚将极其危险，但尽管如此，抛锚的命令仍被重复，我们服从了。随后开了一枪。

海军陆战队接管
‘二话不说，海关船只靠帮，七名全副武装的海军陆战队员跳上船侧，命令我们谨慎驶往吴淞，我们照办了。入侵者检查了我们货物的性质和数量。当我们到达吴淞时，武器、弹药和炸药被扣押并存放在莱路（Lay Road）的政府军火库中。’
船长说，他在马尼拉时，接到汉堡公司官员通过电报发出的指令，要求直接前往上海，不要进入中国南部水域。

担心被俘
‘在许多港口，我间接听到中国领事已收到警告，要监视“R. C. 瑞克梅尔”号的动向。当我在马尼拉收到直接前往上海的消息时，我推断公司官员担心，如果我们进入中国

THE CHINA PRESS, SUNDAY, AUGUST 23, 1931

Munitions Taken
From Hold Of
German Vessel

500 Cases Of Ammunition
Reported Confiscated
Aboard Bona

THREAT OF
BOYCOTT MADE

'Armored Chinese Launch
Trains Guns On
Steamer

A shipment of 500 cases of arms and ammunition originally consigned to the Cantonese government was reported seized by a national government armored launch late last night as the s.s. Bona, Rickmer Line steamer, attempted to bring its cargo into port.

The Bona, a German steamer which loaded first at Hamburg and later took on a large cargo of iron at Antwerp came direct to Shanghai from Manila. The government launch was heavily armed, and many customs men were stationed along the course taken by the German ship to insure complete confiscation of the arms. It is believed that the national government will transfer the small arsenal to its own store of ammunition.

Reports indicate that the national government learned that the German ship was on its way East with the arms for Cantonese. Nationalist heads are said to have cabled German authorities that if the cargo of ammunition were delivered to Kwangtung forces, German ships would be boycotted from all North China ports. Consequently the German ship made no stop between Manila and Shanghai.

The landing of German arms here by order of the nationalist government, comes close on the heels of a boycott against German goods in Kwangtung launched on Friday. The German consul at Canton was reported to have been endeavoring to smooth things over in the South, but it is said that his efforts are proving fruitless, since the Cantonese are convinced that the Germans are "pro-Nanking."

《字林西报》，1931年8月23日，星期日

从德国船只
货舱中查获
军火

据报道“博纳”号船上
500箱弹药被没收

发出
抵制威胁

‘装甲中国汽艇
用炮口对准
轮船

据报道，昨晚深夜，当瑞克梅尔轮船公司的蒸汽船“博纳”号（s.s. Bona）试图将其货物带入港口时，国民政府的一艘装甲汽艇扣押了原系托运给广东政府的500箱武器和弹药。

“博纳”号是一艘德国轮船，首先在汉堡装载，后来在安特卫普装载了大量铁矿石，从马尼拉直接驶往上海。政府汽艇武装精良，许多海关人员部署在德国船只航行的路线上，以确保完全没收武器。据信，国民政府将把这个小型军火库转移到其自己的弹药储备中。

报告显示，国民政府得知该德国船只正携带供广东方面使用的军火向东航行。据说国民党高层已向德国当局发电称，如果将弹药货物交付给广东部队，德国船只将在所有华北港口受到抵制。因此，该德国船只在马尼拉和上海之间未作停留。

奉国民党政府之命在此登陆德国军火，紧随周五在广东发起的抵制德货运动之后。据报道，驻广州德国领事一直在努力缓和南方局势，但据说他的努力证明是徒劳的，因为广东人确信德国人是“亲南京”的。

The China Press, Monday, August 24, 1931.

Policemen Guard
Against Attempt
To Retake Arms

Shipment Intended For
Canton Unloaded
In Shanghai

A large quantity of machine guns, dynamite, rifles, airplanes, and ammunition originally consigned to Canton was brought into Shanghai yesterday with the German liner. "R. C. Rickmers" and deposited in the Lay Road godown, it was reported last night.

The customs cruiser, a heavily armed Customs launch, and a score of river police stood guard over the vessel from the time it was escorted into Chinese limits of jurisdiction Saturday night until the cargo was unloaded yesterday. Police were prepared for possible intervention by Cantonese confederates who might attempt to gain control of the ship and drive it back to sea, where the arms consignment might be transferred to Canton-bound vessels.

As reported exclusively in yesterday's China Press, the arms had been loaded in Europe and dispatched to Kwangtung Province. Nanking officials, it was said, learned of the proposed delivery and ordered its transfer to Shanghai under punishment of boycott of all German vessels from Northern ports in the event of the ship's failure to comply with these orders. As a result, the ship came directly here from Manila, was met at the Chinese limits by a heavily-armed escort, and brought to Woosung, where it was detained under a large guard until the arms were deposited in the godown. The ship then proceeded up river to its berth on the Pootung shore.

The seizure closely follows a report that the German consul at Canton is having great difficulty in staving off a threatened boycott on German products because of the allegedly "pro-Nanking" attitude of Germany.

Last night, it was said that the dynamite had been destined for Japan, but the rest of the cargo bore Canton tags.

The amount of armament and ammunition could not be determined definitely yesterday, and the disposal of it was not certain, but it was generally believed that the national government would take over the entire arm shipment.

《字林西报》，1931年8月24日，星期一。

警察守卫
防止企图
夺回军火

原定运往广州的
货物在上海
卸货

据报道，昨晚，大量机枪、达纳迈特炸药、步枪、飞机和弹药随德国班轮“R. C. 瑞克梅尔”号运抵上海，并存放在莱路（Lay Road）仓库。

从周六晚该船被护送至中国管辖界限起，直到昨日货物卸完为止，海关巡舰、一艘重武装海关汽艇和二十名水上警察一直守护着该船。警方准备应对广东同伙可能进行的干预，这些人可能会试图控制船只并将其驱回海上，以便将军火转运至开往广州的船只。

正如昨天《字林西报》独家报道的那样，这批军火是在欧洲装载并发往广东省的。据说南京官员得知了拟议的交付计划，并下令将其转移至上海，如果船只不遵守这些命令，所有德国船只将在北方港口受到抵制。结果，该船从马尼拉直接来到这里，在中国界限处由重武装护航队接应，并被带至吴淞，在那里由大量警卫扣留，直到军火存入仓库。随后该船溯江而上，驶往其在浦东岸边的泊位。

此次扣押紧接着一则报告，即驻广州德国领事因德国 allegedly “亲南京”的态度，在阻止对德国产品的威胁性抵制方面面临巨大困难。

昨晚，据说达纳迈特炸药的目的地是日本，但其余货物贴有广东标签。

昨天无法确定武器和弹药的确切数量，其处置也不确定，但人们普遍认为国民政府将接管整批军火装运。

The China Press, Monday, August 24, 1931.

Germany's Refusal To Sell Canton
Arms Cause Of Boycott Movement

(Special To The China Press)
CANTON, Aug. 23.—It is learned that the present anti-German feeling among official circles in Canton arose out of the German government's recent refusal to permit the exportation of a large shipment of arms and ammunition to Canton.
According to well-informed circles, the Canton authorities placed with a German concern a $1,000,000 order for arms some time ago and paid a deposit of $200,000 at the signing of the contract.

Unfortunately, when the German firm applied to Berlin for permit to release the shipment of arms, the Reich government rejected the application on the ground that the Canton government was not an officially recognized government in China and therefore Germany was not in a position to allow such exportation of arms.
The action of the German government immediately called forth a wave of resentment from the Canton authorities who are alleged to be devising measures of retaliation.

《字林西报》，1931年8月24日，星期一。

德国拒绝向广东出售军火
引发抵制运动

（《字林西报》专讯）
广州，8月23日。— 获悉，目前广州官方圈子中的反德情绪源于德国政府最近拒绝允许向广东出口大批武器和弹药。
据消息灵通人士称，广东当局不久前向一家德国公司下达了价值100万美元的军火订单，并在签署合同时支付了20万美元的定金。

不幸的是，当这家德国公司向柏林申请放行这批军火的许可时，帝国政府以广东政府不是中国正式承认的政府为由拒绝了申请，因此德国无法允许此类军火出口。
德国政府的行动立即引起了广东当局的愤慨浪潮，据称他们正在策划报复措施。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P.
C. I. D. REGIST.
No. I. O. 8760/111.
Date. 22 - 12 - 30.
December 21, 1930.

S. 1
Please prepare statistics of arms being
imported into China as contraband which were seized
by the Customs during 1930. It is probable that these
statistics have already been compiled by P.A. (C. & S.Brs)
for the annual Crime Report. If not we should give them
in our report. This information is very important from
a political point of view in view of the plans being
made by local Communists to create disorder in the rear
of General Chiang Kai-shek's army and the practice of
Communists to use assassination for the purpose of terrori-
zing labour and maintaining discipline in their own ranks.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

S. 1
请编制1930年间海关查获的作为违禁品输入中国的武器统计数据。这些统计数据可能已由警务处助理处长（刑事及特别分支）为年度犯罪报告编制完毕。若未编制，我们应在我们的报告中提供。鉴于当地共产党人正策划在蒋介石将军军队后方制造混乱，以及共产党人惯用暗杀手段来恐吓劳工并维持其内部纪律，从政治角度来看，此信息非常重要。

特别分支主管警官。

Sir,
April 6, 1931
25 cases of rifles, 5 cases of bayonets and 125 cases
of ammunition which were imported from Hamburg in the s.s.

Road, and stored in the Lay Road Godown, were removed from the

was then loaded in the steamer and forwarded to Anking.

Sir,
February 28, 1931
29 cases of rifles and 50 cases of cartridges, which were

and after being loaded on a cargo boat, were taken under an
escort of three armed Customs officers along Whangpoo River to
the s.s. "Kiang Main" of the China Merchants Steam Ship Co.,
which was lying alongside the Company's wharf at French Bund,
the cargo was then loaded in the steamer, which sailed for
Hankow on the same date.

February 28, 1931
16 cases of safety cartridges, which were imported in
Shanghai from Hamburg as follows:-
8 cases in the s.s. "Andes Maru" N.Y.K.
1 case in the s.s. "Asaka Maru" N.Y.K.
7 cases in the s.s. "Flens" of the Arnold Line
by Messrs. Carlowitz and Co., 220 Szechuen Road, in the beginning
of February 1931 and stored in the Day Road Godown, were removed
from the godown on February 28, 1931 under a Luchow issued by the
Nanking Government by the Asia Transportation Co., and after being
loaded on a cargo boat, were taken under an escort of 3 armed
Customs officers along the Whangpoo River to the s.s. "Kiang Main"
of the China Merchants Steam Ship Co., which was lying alongside
the Company's wharf at French Bund, the cargo was then loaded in
the steamer and taken to Hankow on the same date.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
V. Ovsianikoff
D. S.

Subject (in full) Arms Smuggling on French Steamer.
Made by D. I. Robertson Forwarded by
Inquiries made in connection with a report
on the subject referred to above which appeared in the
China Times of November 16, 1930, go to show that at
5 a.m. November 15, 1930, Wang Chi Heng, an inspector
of the Water Police attached to the Public Safety Bureau and
an alleged former arms smuggler, observed two bags being
lowered from the D'artagnan, which was berthed near the
Whangpoo Wharf on the Pootung side of the river, into a
waiting sampan. In order to intimidate the occupants of
the sampan Wang Chi Heng and his assistants fired several
shots into the air whereupon the occupants jumped on
shore and succeeded in making good their escape in the
semi-darkness. Wang Chi Heng then seized the two bags
which were found to contain 42 Browning pistols.
Henry Robertson
D. I.
D. C. (Cr. & Sp. Branches).

November 16, 1930. Morning translation.

ARMS SMUGGLING ON FRENCH STEAMER

The following report appears
in the China Times and other local newspapers:-
In the early hours of November 15
the Chinese Water Police kept a watch on a French
steamer berthed near the Whangpoo Jetty. At 5.30 a.m.
they discovered two gunny bags being removed to an old
ferry boat. One of the Chinese detectives went
forward and simultaneously two pistol shots were heard.
The Chinese detective also fired. The bag was found
to contain 42 Browning pistols and 48 magazines.
The two men on the ferry boat succeeded in making good
their escape.

1930年11月16日。晨间译文。

法国轮船上走私军火

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：-
11月15日凌晨，中国水上警察监视了一艘停泊在黄浦码头附近的法国轮船。上午5时30分，他们发现有两个麻袋被搬运到一艘旧渡船上。一名中国侦探上前，同时听到两声手枪射击声。该中国侦探也开了枪。经查，袋内装有42支勃朗宁手枪和48个弹匣。渡船上的两名男子成功逃脱。

Enquiries were made by the undersigned, J.D.S. Kobayashi

Private Indian Watchman No.5 Sohan Singh, employed at the

stated that at about 4:45 a.m. 15-11-30 whilst he was walking
on the wharf near the Customs Luggage Examination Shed, he
heard a police whistle being blown and immediately afterwards
three shots fired in rapid succession. The sound came from the
direction of the Whangpoo River. As two steamers, the "Choshun
Maru" and "D'Artangan" were berthed alongside the Whangpoo Wha-
rf, he was unable to see what was taking place on the river, the
ships obstructing his view.
Another private Indian watchman, No.6, Hazarah Singh, who
was also on night duty, but on the eastern end of the wharf,
corroborated the above statement and added that on the morning
they reported the matter to the sub-manager of the Whangpoo
Wharf, Mr. M. Takata, who told them not to take notice of it,
as the occurrence probably took place in the middle of the
river.
Tsang Hsi Tsoo, private watchman No.2, also on night duty,
corroborated the statements of the Indian Watchmen. He did not
see anything unusual on the wharf before or after the shooting.

制作人 D.S. Wittinsky。 转呈人
先生，
下述人员即本人、J.D.S. Kobayashi 和 C.D.S. 14 进行了调查，获悉情况如下：-
受雇于杨树浦路黄浦码头的印度私人看守员第5号 Sohan Singh，他在1930年11月14日下午6时至1930年11月15日上午6时在码头值夜班，陈述称在1930年11月15日凌晨4时45分左右，当他在海关行李查验棚附近的码头上行走时，听到警哨声，紧接着听到三声快速连续的枪响。声音来自黄浦江方向。由于“长顺丸”（Choshun Maru）和“达塔尼安”号（D'Artangan）两艘轮船停靠在黄浦码头旁，船只遮挡了他的视线，使他无法看到江面上发生的情况。
另一名印度私人看守员第6号 Hazarah Singh，也在值夜班，但位于码头的东端，证实了上述陈述，并补充说，当天早上他们向黄浦码头副经理 M. Takata 先生报告了此事，后者告诉他们不必理会，因为事件可能发生在江中心。
同样值夜班的华人私人看守员第2号曾希祖（Tsang Hsi Tsoo，音译），也证实了印度看守员的陈述。他在枪击前后未在码头上看到任何异常情况。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, MAY 30, 1930.

MUNITIONS SEIZED ON
VESSEL HERE
River And Settlement
Police Make Five
Arrests

A well-organized scheme to
smuggle a large quantity of fire-
arms into China early yesterday
morning resulted in the seizure
by the River and Settlement police
of 21,000 rounds of Mauser am-
munition, 23,000 rounds of .32
calibre cartridges, 135 Spanish
automatic pistols, 57 clips and 45
wooden holders for Mausers.

The arms and ammunition were
secreted on a native junk, which
a police party under Sergeant R.
E. Bridges of the River Police
boarded on information received.
A boatman, who was arrested,
told the police that he had been
asked by one Wong Kwang-yue
to transport the contraband from
Honan Road Jetty to Signal Creek.
In company with officers of the
River Police, Detective Sergeant
W. H. Biggs and several Chinese
police officers subsequently raided
55-a Shantaikwan Road at about
4 o'clock yesterday morning, and
arrested Wong, who was in bed.
A number of other raids were
later carried out, resulting in the
arrest of three coolies residing in
Chinese territory, who were found
in possession of a large quantity
of wooden cases, believed to have
been used for unloading the con-
traband from a steamer, which
arrived a few days ago from a
European port.

Wong was brought up before
Judge Sung yesterday in the
Shanghai Special District Court
when an application was granted
for his extradition to the Chinese
authorities for trial. Sergeant
Biggs stated that certain boatmen
were working under Wong's
directions.

This is the second big seizure
of firearms this week by the local
authorities. The first was made
on the river near the French bund,
when officers of the Public Safety
Bureau found 535 guns in a native
cargo boat, believed to have been
shipped to China on a French
steamer.

在此地船只上查获军火
水上警察与租界警察逮捕五人

昨天凌晨，一个组织严密的向中国走私大量枪支的计划导致水上警察和租界警察查获了21,000发毛瑟子弹、23,000发.32口径子弹、135支西班牙自动手枪、57个弹夹和45个毛瑟手枪木套。

这些军火和弹药藏匿在一艘中国帆船上，水上警察 R. E. Bridges 警长率领的一队警察根据收到的情报登上了该船。一名被捕的船夫告诉警察，他受 Wong Kwang-yue（音译）之托，将违禁品从河南路码头运至信号台浜（Signal Creek）。随后，侦探警长 W. H. Biggs 与几名中国警官一起，于昨天凌晨4点左右突袭了山海关路55-a号，逮捕了正在床上的 Wong。后来又进行了多次突袭，结果逮捕了三名居住在中国境内的苦力，发现他们拥有大量木箱，据信这些木箱曾被用于从几天前从欧洲港口抵达的一艘轮船上卸下载有违禁品的货物。

昨天，Wong 在上海特区法院被带上宋法官面前，法庭批准将其引渡给中国当局受审。Biggs 警长陈述称，某些船夫在 Wong 的指挥下工作。

这是本周地方当局第二次大规模查获枪支。第一次是在法外滩附近的江面上，当时公安局官员在一艘中国货船上发现了535支枪，据信这些枪支是通过一艘法国轮船运往中国的。

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

May 30, 1930.

Seizure of firearms by the Chinese Police.

From enquiries made at the Public Safety Bureau it was ascertained that on the early morning of May 23 the Water Police of the Public Safety Bureau received information that a large consignment of arms was being shipped to Shanghai by a French mail boat. A number of Constables were despatched on a launch to the vicinity of the China Merchants Middle Wharf to wait for the arrival of the cargo. At 2 a.m. they noticed a French steamer discharging parcels of cargo into a lighter. Before the vessel began to move, the Chinese Police fired a shot to stop it. The occupants of the lighter threw several parcels into the water and jumped ashore. One of the gang named Siao Siao Ker Tsz 小小子 who was slow in escaping, was arrested and taken on to the Police launch. The authorities seized 56 mauser pistols and 5200 rounds of ammunition on board whilst 35 mausers and 3000 rounds of ammunition were picked up from the water. All these arms and ammunition and the lighter were removed to Nantao. The prisoner upon being interrogated gave the name of the owner of the cargo as Tang Siao Jeu Tsz 唐□□. A circular order has been issued for his arrest.

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记

1930年5月30日。

中国警方查获枪支。

经向公安局查询获悉，5月23日凌晨，公安局水警接到情报，称有一大批军火正由一艘法国邮船运往上海。数名巡警乘汽艇被派往招商局中码头附近等候货物抵达。凌晨2时，他们注意到一艘法国轮船正在将包裹卸入驳船。在该船开始移动前，中国警察开枪示警以阻止其离开。驳船上的人员将数个包裹抛入水中并跳上岸。一名绰号为“小小子”（Siao Siao Ker Tsz）的帮伙成员因逃跑迟缓被捕，并被带上警用汽艇。当局在船上查获56支毛瑟手枪及5200发子弹，另从水中打捞起35支毛瑟手枪及3000发子弹。所有上述军火、弹药及驳船均被移送至南市。经审讯，囚犯供出货主名为唐□□（Tang Siao Jeu Tsz）。已发布通缉令对其进行逮捕。
